data.body:
Survey continuation checkpoint.

- Refreshed the survey worktree to origin/main commit e2f7b130e039402fa194f3bd8c25e77c8e3fa75c. HEAD matches that revision and the worktree is clean.
- Gerrit changes 2209 and 2211 are open under the shared configured identity. Neither change originates from this worktree. Both have LLM-Review +1 and await Verified.
- Excluded rejected F02, F03, and F04, deferred F05, reconsidered F24, and work completed or active through F49.
- F50 would align force override guidance with the canonical human-operator boundary while preserving every supported override.
- F51 would correct the README publication model to describe automatic push attempts, strict delivery when configured, and preserved local backlog after delivery failure.
- F52 would remove retired flat-configuration and HMAC claims from maintained guidance and source comments.
- F53 would separate Jira synchronization setup from this repository's deployment history and operational record.
- F54 would separate MCP client authentication setup from implementation detail and establish one canonical security source.
- F55 would reconcile the documented AWS HMAC secret requirement with the asymmetric operation certificate path and its infrastructure wiring.
- Remaining work covers exact source ownership, historical ticket and ADR grounding, implementation-scope boundaries, and an independent conformance filter.

No repository files changed.
